tools.name: find_inks_by_color
tools.description: Find fountain pen inks whose color looks closest to a hex color, closest first. Each ink has its swatch image, water resistance image, and its page on inkpalette.co.

tools.name: search_inks
tools.description: Search fountain pen inks by brand or name (for example "iroshizuku" or "pilot kon-peki"). match tells what came back: "exact" for name matches; "color" when no name matched but the query is a color, so these are inks of that color; "closest" when the spelling was off, so inks holds the closest name

tools.name: find_similar_inks
tools.description: Find inks similar to one ink, given by name (for example "tsuki-yo" or "Sailor Yama-dori"). basis tells why they are similar: "on_record" for inks InkPalette lists as similar; "color" when none are on record, so these are inks of a close color. tools.name: get_ink_details
tools.description: Describe one ink: a summary, how it writes (flow, dry time, shading, sheen, water resistance), shimmer, iron gall, good uses, its swatch, writing samples people posted, reviews, similar inks, and its page on inkpalette.co. tools.name: ink_of_the_day
tools.description: One fountain pen ink for today, the same for everyone on the same day (UTC). Introduce it by how it looks and writes, show its swatch, and give its page link. Set language to "ja" when the user writes in Japanese.
